title: silene borysthenica subsp. parviflora
intro: Silene borysthenica subsp. parviflora, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the carnation family, is a subspecies of Silene borysthenica. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene borysthenica subsp. parviflora include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
